content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP® credential. PMI sets specific thresholds for both formal education and hands-on hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy's advisors can review your background and confirm readiness before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Boot Camp designed for working professionals in Wichita. Our expert instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours through structured, interactive sessions you can attend from your office or home, balancing work and study.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, submit your official PMI application documenting your project experience and education. Pay the associated PMI examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the application process and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's comprehensive exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor support. Schedule your PMP® exam through PMI's approved testing provider. Our academy provides targeted review sessions to strengthen weak areas and build confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, certifications, and project-management activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and resources to help you maintain your credential and stay current with industry standards.
